expression_alternatives.role: Complete dated source-only conditional expression-boundary candidates and finite public caller/compiler qualification; no original coordinate selection or private/toolchain promotion.

legs.durability: Complete immutable original inventory, full source/recipe alternatives, fixed intake/source authorities, sealed matching programmes/products and normal Git commit.
legs.falsify: verify.py separately walks every complete original phase interval, reconstructs all used/full recipe and own/opaque allocations and actually replays sealed original/source readers; genuine caller, line, source and omission controls.
legs.rederive: match.py admitted source-link positions and original coordinates with all independently qualified source-expression alternatives and committed source-selected observer associations.
